units.source_text: 比如，我收到過咖啡酒吧一位女孩稚拙的情書；

en.t: For example, I once received a clumsy love letter from a girl at a cafe bar;

units.source_text: 櫻木町鄰居將軍家一位二十來歲的女兒，每天早晨在我去上學的時間段裡，

en.t: The twenty-year-old daughter of the general's family next door in Sakuragicho, every morning around the time I left for school,

units.source_text: 明明沒什麼事，卻化著淡妝在自己家門前進進出出；

en.t: though she plainly had no errand, she would put on light makeup and go in and out in front of her own gate;

units.source_text: 去吃牛肉飯時，就算我一言不發，那位女店員也會……

en.t: when I went to eat beef rice, even if I said nothing at all, the waitress would...

units.source_text: 還有我常去買菸的那家香菸店的女兒，她遞給我的香菸盒中竟然有……

en.t: and then there was the daughter of the tobacco shop where I often bought cigarettes; in the cigarette box she handed me, there was, incredibly...

units.source_text: 去看歌舞伎時，鄰座的女孩……

en.t: when I went to see kabuki, the girl in the seat beside me...

units.source_text: 在深夜的電車上，因喝多睡著時……

en.t: on a late-night train, when I had drunk too much and fallen asleep...

units.source_text: 意想不到從老家親戚的女兒那裡寄來的遐思遙愛的情書……

en.t: a love letter, unexpectedly sent by a daughter of relatives back home, full of distant longing...

units.source_text: 不知是哪位素不相識的女孩，趁我不在家時送來親手製作的布娃娃……

en.t: some girl I had never met and did not even know brought a handmade cloth doll while I was away from home...

units.source_text: 由於我的極度消極，每一次都僅此而已，只是一個殘缺的斷片，

en.t: because I was so extremely passive, each time it went no further than that, remaining only an incomplete fragment,
and nothing ever developed beyond it.
